entities.summary: Sonal Ambani is a renowned Indian sculptor and author, born in 1985 in Mumbai, India. Her works explore the intersection of traditional Indian art forms with modern techniques, often incorporating themes of social justice and environmental sustainability. Through her art, she has contributed significantly to the contemporary Indian art scene, collaborating with various artists and curators, and exhibiting her work internationally. Her sculptures have been featured in several exhibitions, including the prestigious India Art Fair in New Delhi. She has also written extensively on art and culture, publishing several books and articles on the subject. Sonal Ambani's work has been widely praised for its innovative approach, technical skill, and commitment to social and environmental causes. Her legacy continues to inspire a new generation of artists and art enthusiasts in India and beyond.
